title: Econ Playground: Guardrails and Rollout Scheduler for Batch/Cache/Quant Trials
creator: Marta Kline
description: Create an internal 'Econ Playground' product surface that lets PMs/Eng/REs run controlled field experiments for batching, KV prefix caching, and quantization profiles with production-like traffic. The Playground should provide experiment templates, automated guardrails (latency/quality/cost thresholds), a rollout scheduler with canary/A-B/percentage ramps, and automatic rollback policies tied to SLO regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment templates for batching, KV cache TTLs, and quant profiles available in the console
Guardrail rules: end-to-end P95 latency, token-level perplexity delta, and cost-per-1k-token thresholds configurable per experiment
Rollout scheduler supports canary -> progressive ramp -> full rollout with automated rollback on thresholds
Experiment registry logs: inputs, model variant, rollout windows, metrics snapshots, and owner metadata
Metrics surfaced in a lightweight dashboard and exportable to external monitoring (Datadog/Grafana)
Audit trail and KMS-backed config encryption for private deployments
tasks: PM: finalize experiment templates and default guardrail thresholds
ENG: build rollout scheduler API and hook into traffic router
ENG: integrate experiment metadata into trace/span tags for latency attribution
Eng Infra: add feature flag gate and RBAC for Playground access
DX: UX flows for creating experiments and viewing live dashboards
QA: create synthetic workloads and integration tests for rollback behavior
Security: run threat model for config encryption and audit logs
